description: Block destructive git and shell commands, commands that skip Git hooks, and tool calls that would leak a secret into Claude's context; at session start, in order: create or complete the repo's .harness.json with every setting off, report what's wrong with it, generate the Git hooks it lists, install its status line and, with guidelines on, add the plugin's working rules to the context; after a session where sessionReview is on (by default, where .about/ exists), review it with the glossary and adr skills

hooks.command: if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session-start.ts"; fi
if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard.ts"; fi
if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session-review.ts"; fi
